description: NaNbO₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmn space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.62-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.87 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.71 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.92 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.53 Å) and two longer (2.73 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.90 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.60-2.79 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.70 Å. There are three inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-17°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.01 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and  a faceface with one NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-23°. There are four shorter (2.01 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-23°. There are two shorter (2.01 Å) and four longer (2.02 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Nb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Nb atoms.
